title.en: Authorizing Minors to Deposit With and Withdraw From

text.en:
Minors who are at least seven years of age, are able to read and write, have sufficient discretion,
and are not otherwise disqualified by any other incapacity, are hereby vested with special capacity and power,
in their own right and in their own names, to make savings or time deposits with and withdraw the same as
well as receive interests thereon from banking institutions, without the assistance of their parents or guardians,
the provisions of existing laws and regulations to the contrary notwithstanding. Parents may nevertheless
deposit for their minor children and guardians for their wards.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-five.
